name: alarm
description: Set a reminder for your future self. A due alarm appears in the system prompt of every later run until handled, so use it to follow up on things that need time to pass: "check whether CI went green", "re-poll the peer", "revisit the stuck goal". One-shot: {"action":"set","message":"...","in_minutes":20} or with "at":<epoch seconds>. Recurring: add "every_minutes":30. {"action":"list"} shows all with due flags. When you have acted on a due alarm, call {"action":"done","id":"a-..."}: a one-shot is removed, a recurring one advances to its next occurrence. {"action":"cancel","id":"a-..."} deletes outright.
